name: adf-dev
description: The Agentic Development Framework's development plugin: skills for building, running, and checking the code. /adf-dev:dev-env sets up, diagnoses, and safely resets a Docker Compose local environment (the docker module), /adf-dev:e2e sets up Playwright end-to-end tests and their smoke suite (the e2e module), and /adf-dev:unit sets up Vitest unit and integration tests, run by tier and by feature suite (the unit module); like every module skill, each acts only in a packaged project that installed its module.
